tools.name: rpc_create
tools.description: Execute the cleanup_agent_memory stored procedure, which removes stale or expired agent memory records from the BrainOS database. No parameters required. Returns the count of deleted rows or a status indicator from the Postgres function.

tools.name: rpc_create-cleanupexpiredcheckpoints
tools.description: Execute the cleanup_expired_checkpoints stored procedure, which removes NatureOS agent checkpoints past their expiry time. No parameters required. Call periodically to prevent checkpoint table bloat. Returns a status or count from the Postgres function.

tools.name: rpc_create-cleanupexpiredsessions
tools.description: Execute the cleanup_expired_sessions stored procedure, which removes expired MCP session records from mcp_sessions. No parameters required. Call periodically to keep the sessions table pruned. Returns a status or count from the Postgres function.

tools.name: rpc_create-cleanupoldlogs
tools.description: Execute the cleanup_old_logs stored procedure, which deletes aged-out MCP activity log entries. No parameters required. Returns a status or row count from the Postgres function. Use the mcp reliability command to check current log volume before running.

tools.name: rpc_create-enqueuetasks
tools.description: Execute the enqueue_tasks stored procedure, which inserts pending work items into the NatureOS task queue in bulk. No parameters required at the RPC level (task data is passed via request body per the stored procedure's contract). Returns the number of tasks enqueued or their ids.

tools.name: rpc_create-getrunresults
tools.description: Execute the get_run_results stored procedure, which retrieves the output of a completed NatureOS agent run. No parameters required at the RPC level (run id is passed via request body). Returns the result payload from the Postgres function.

tools.name: rpc_create-isvalidsession
tools.description: Execute the is_valid_session stored procedure, which checks whether a given MCP session token is still active and unexpired. Pass the session token via the request body. Returns a boolean or status object from the Postgres function.

tools.name: rpc_create-matchthoughts
tools.description: Execute the match_thoughts stored procedure, which performs semantic vector search over the thoughts table using embeddings. Returns thoughts most similar to the input embedding. Use for agent retrieval tasks where keyword search is insufficient. Prefer the brainos search command for interactive queries.

tools.name: rpc_create-readagentmemory
tools.description: Execute the read_agent_memory stored procedure, which retrieves the active memory context for a specific NatureOS agent. Pass the agent identifier via request body. Returns the agent's current memory state as a structured object.

tools.name: rpc_create-searchdocuments
tools.description: Execute the search_documents stored procedure, which performs full-text search across the documents table. Returns matching documents ranked by relevance. Use for hybrid or FTS-only document retrieval from Postgres. Prefer the brainos search command for interactive queries.

tools.name: rpc_create-searchdocumentskeyword
tools.description: Execute the search_documents_keyword stored procedure, which performs keyword-only (BM25/trgm) search over documents. Returns documents matching the keyword query ranked by text similarity. Use when you want keyword precision without vector embeddings.

tools.name: rpc_create-searchdocumentsvector
tools.description: Execute the search_documents_vector stored procedure, which performs vector similarity search over the documents table using pgvector embeddings. Returns documents nearest to the input embedding vector. Use for semantic retrieval over stored knowledge base content.

tools.name: rpc_create-searchthoughtshybrid
tools.description: Execute the search_thoughts_hybrid stored procedure, which combines vector similarity and keyword search over the thoughts table. Returns thoughts most relevant to the input using RRF or hybrid scoring. Use for the best balance of precision and recall in thought retrieval.

tools.name: rpc_create-showlimit
tools.description: Execute the show_limit stored procedure (POST variant), which returns the current Postgres max connections or query-level limits configured for the BrainOS Supabase project. No parameters. Returns a numeric limit value from the database function.

tools.name: rpc_create-showtrgm
tools.description: Execute the show_trgm stored procedure (POST variant), which returns the current pg_trgm similarity threshold used for trigram text search in the BrainOS database. No parameters. Returns the numeric threshold value.

tools.name: rpc_create-upsertagentmemory
tools.description: Execute the upsert_agent_memory stored procedure, which inserts or updates a memory record for a specific NatureOS agent. Pass agent id and memory payload via request body. Returns the resulting memory row after upsert.

tools.name: rpc_create-upsertcheckpoint
tools.description: Execute the upsert_checkpoint stored procedure, which saves or updates a NatureOS agent checkpoint in natureos_agent_checkpoints. Pass the checkpoint payload via request body. Returns the resulting checkpoint row after upsert.

tools.name: rpc_list
tools.description: List. Required: query_embedding, query_text. Optional: source_types, match_count, vector_weight.

tools.name: rpc_list-searchdocumentskeyword
tools.description: List searchdocumentskeyword. Required: search_query, source_type_filter. Optional: match_count.

tools.name: rpc_list-searchdocumentsvector
tools.description: List searchdocumentsvector. Required: query_embedding, source_type_filter. Optional: match_count.

tools.name: rpc_list-searchthoughtshybrid
tools.description: List searchthoughtshybrid. Required: query_embedding, query_text. Optional: match_threshold, match_count, filter_project.

tools.name: rpc_list-showlimit
tools.description: Call the show_limit stored procedure via GET, returning the Postgres connection limit configured for the BrainOS Supabase project. No parameters. Returns a numeric value. Equivalent to the POST variant rpc_create-showlimit but uses GET semantics.

tools.name: rpc_list-showtrgm
tools.description: Call the show_trgm stored procedure via GET, returning the pg_trgm trigram similarity threshold currently in effect for text search in the BrainOS database. No parameters. Returns the numeric threshold value. Required: .
